title: Ken Burns pan/zoom path generator
summary: Per-frame crop rectangles for pan and zoom moves over a still, kept inside the image, log-space zoom, eased, with named presets and an upscale-risk measure.
examples: Zoom in 15% on the subject's face over 5 seconds
Pan right across a wide 4:3 photo for a 9:16 short

review.notes: Unit tests pass with pytest on Python 3.13 (numpy, Pillow); ffmpeg integration tests ran with ffmpeg present.
